extDescription.message: Double-click a word for an English definition, pronunciation, and example sentences. Connected cards open on their own.

popupLead.message: Double-click an English or Chinese word to look it up.

popupEnable.message: Look up words on web pages

popupReadFailed.message: Could not read settings. Reopen the extension.

popupEnabledOn.message: On. Open pages pick this up as well.

popupEnabledOff.message: Paused. Takes effect the next time you select a word.

optionsLead.message: This browser language shows the English definition, pronunciation, and example sentences. Chinese glosses stay on the Chinese interface.

optionSmart.message: Chinese first · Wiktionary with an English fallback, no key

optionFree.message: Free Dictionary · English definitions, no key

optionOxford.message: Oxford Dictionaries API · official access required

optionCambridge.message: Cambridge Dictionary API · official access required

noteSmart.message: The Chinese interface asks WiktApi first and falls back to Free Dictionary. The English interface does not use that path.

noteWiktionary.message: The Chinese interface shows Chinese Wiktionary glosses from api.wiktapi.dev. The English interface does not request that service.

noteFree.message: Queries the Free Dictionary API at api.dictionaryapi.dev. The card shows the English definition, pronunciation, and any example sentence the service already includes. No key or local service is required.

noteDemo.message: An offline sample of 12 original entries, such as serendipity, luminous, ephemeral, and apple. The English card uses the English definition, phonetic, and example sentence.

noteOxford.message: Connects to the Oxford Dictionaries API through the local service. An App ID and App Key are required. The English card keeps only the English definition, pronunciation, and example sentences.

noteCambridge.message: Connects to the official Cambridge API through the local service. Access approval, an access key, and an authorized dictionary code are required. Chinese fields from a bilingual dataset are not shown on the English card.

bridgeLead.message: Official dictionary keys belong only in the project’s bridge/.env file. Enter the BRIDGE_TOKEN from that same file here.

bridgeTokenHelp.message: The service address is fixed at http://127.0.0.1:47821. The token stays in this extension on this computer and is not synced.

bridgeDocs.message: Startup and application steps are in the project README. Available Cambridge dictionary codes come from the service’s /v1/dictionaries route.

guide1.message: Double-click an English or Chinese word, or select words and click Look up.

guide2.message: Click the card to open the English definition, pronunciation, and examples. Click the headword again to close it.

guide3.message: Drag across several words, then click Look up to make a connected row of cards.

guide4.message: Hold Ctrl / ⌘ and double-click another word to append it, up to 8.

guide5.message: Click close or press Esc. Chrome internal pages, the store, and the built-in PDF viewer are not injected.

settingsFooter.message: Only a word you choose to look up is sent. Page contents are not uploaded and lookup history is not stored. The English interface requests English dictionary data and does not show Chinese glosses.

readFailed.message: Could not read settings. Refresh and try again.

tokenShort.message: Enter a local service token of at least 24 characters.

saved.message: Saved. The next lookup uses these settings without a page refresh.

saveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Try again.

restored.message: The form is back to its defaults. Click Save settings to apply them.

bridgeConnected.message: Local service connected. Oxford: $1. Cambridge: $2. A configured credential is not proof of a live authorized lookup.

bridgeCheckFailed.message: The connection check failed. Try again.

bridgeListing.message: Reading the dictionaries this account can access…

bridgeListHint.message: Put the dictionaryCode you need in CAMBRIDGE_DICTIONARY_CODE in bridge/.env, then restart the service:

bridgeListEmpty.message: The account did not return an available dictionary. Check the authorization.

bridgeListFailed.message: Could not read the list. Check the local service and Cambridge access.

tryEyebrow.message: Follow a word. Find a world.

tryHeroLead.message: You do not have to stop at an unfamiliar word. Double-click a word below and let the English meaning open in front of you. This page uses the original demo entries.

tryCaption.message: Try dragging across “luminous ephemeral”, or use the buttons below.

step1Body.message: Select a word and a compact card appears.

step2Body.message: The definition, pronunciation, and example unfold on one card.

step3Body.message: Drag across several words, then look them up. Ctrl / ⌘ + double-click appends another.

step4Body.message: Click empty space, the close button, or press Esc.

tryFooterDemo.message: English demo entries are original; Chinese entries are looked up online

previewOptionsHint.message: This is the local preview. Load the extension folder in Chrome to open settings from the extension.

footerHelp.message: Double-click a new word to replace · Ctrl / ⌘ + double-click to append

maxWords.message: View up to $1 different words at a time.

audioUnavailable.message: Audio is unavailable. Use the system voice.

speechUnsupported.message: This browser cannot speak with the system voice.

speechBusy.message: The page is already speaking. Try again shortly.

noExamples.message: This source did not include an example sentence.

sourceDemoNote.message: Original sample text for trying the cards. Not Oxford or Cambridge data.

sourceFreeNote.message: Free Dictionary API · English definition, pronunciation, and examples.

notFound.message: This word could not be found

notFoundHint.message: Check the spelling, or choose another dictionary in settings.

errorRetryHint.message: Check the connection and dictionary settings, then try again.

noticeWiktMissing.message: The Chinese source has no entry. Showing the English definition.

noticeWiktDown.message: The Chinese source is unavailable. Showing the English definition.

noticeUnconfirmed.message: The English source has no entry either, and the Chinese source is unavailable, so this word cannot be confirmed yet.

noticeBothDown.message: Both the Chinese and English sources are unavailable. Try again later.

noticeFreeDown.message: The Chinese source has no entry, and the English source is unavailable.

noticeNoEnglish.message: This authorized result has no English definition to show.

error_not_configured.message: Connect the local dictionary service in settings first.

error_bridge_auth.message: The local service token is not correct. Check settings.

error_busy.message: Other words are being looked up. Try again shortly.

error_bridge_busy.message: The local dictionary service is busy. Try again shortly.

error_bridge_unavailable.message: Could not reach the local dictionary service. Make sure it is running.

error_invalid_word.message: English words support up to 48 characters; Chinese words up to 32 characters.

error_unsupported_format.message: The dictionary returned a format that is not supported yet. Open the original dictionary.

error_authentication.message: Dictionary authorization failed. Check the API credentials and access.

error_rate_limit.message: The dictionary quota is exhausted or requests are too frequent. Try again later.

error_upstream.message: The dictionary service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

error_invalid_dictionary.message: The Cambridge dictionary code does not exist or this key is not authorized for it. Read the available list and check the configuration.

error_integration.message: The Cambridge API path is not valid. Check the integration settings.

error_timeout.message: The dictionary request timed out. Try again.

error_network.message: Could not reach the dictionary. Check the network and try again.

error_demo_miss.message: The demo list does not include this word. Switch to an online dictionary.

error_connection_failed.message: The dictionary connection failed. If the extension just updated, refresh the page and try again.

error_generic.message: The dictionary cannot be reached right now. Try again.

error_http_status.message: Connection failed (HTTP $1). Check the service and token.

error_bridge_down.message: Not connected. Start the local dictionary service first.

regionHelp.message: Some browsers report only Traditional Chinese. Choose Hong Kong or Taiwan here if the automatic region is wrong.

tryChineseLead.message: These words use the online dictionaries. Select one to see its readings, definitions and examples.

tryChineseSample.message: 你好 学习 語言

guidanceLead.message: Pick credited dictionary links by headword language and region. The extension only creates links; it never fetches or rehosts those pages.

guidanceBuiltinHelp.message: Cards show the first three matching links by language and region. Dictionary navigation shows every match.

guidanceCustomHelp.message: Use name | https://example.com/word/{word} for all languages, or fr | name | https://…/{word} for a specific language (en, zh, ja, ko, fr, de, es). Up to six templates; names up to 60 characters and URLs up to 300. Put {word} in the path, query or fragment.

guidanceInvalid.message: Invalid template on line $1: $2. Check its language, length, URL and the six-template limit.

navIntro.message: Choose the headword language and read the definition at its source. Japanese, Korean, French, German and Spanish currently offer dictionary links; webpage word cards support Chinese and English.

navInvalidWord.message: Enter a headword of up to 64 characters without control characters.

navNoSites.message: No enabled sites match this language. Enable a dictionary or add a template for this language in settings.

navAllSites.message: The full matching directory. A site is visited only when you open its link.

navInvalidLanguage.message: Choose a supported headword language. This language code is not in the directory yet.
